title: The consecutive lifting-projection flow as an approximation of Boltzmann and Landau flow
summary: We introduce the consecutive lifting-projection (LP) flow as a novel approximation framework for the spatially homogeneous Boltzmann and Landau equations. The key idea is to lift the nonlinear collision operator to a higher dimensional linear Kac master equation on spheres, evolve this lifted equation in time, and project the solution back to the lower dimensional velocity space. The resulting LP flow is a tangent flow to the original kinetic dynamics and admits a clear semigroup structure.
